faq.a: Within a week. Music video edits take up to two weeks.

faq.q: Do I need to pay upfront?
faq.a: Yes. Full payment locks in your date. Bank transfer, PayPal or cash all work.
Christchurch and around Canterbury. Further out can be sorted, just ask.

faq.q: What's the difference between the two photo options?
faq.a: The $40 shoot is unedited, straight off the camera. The $80 shoot is picked and edited in Lightroom.
Yeah, post them anywhere. Just tag @mosaicscope.

faq.a: A few reference pics or links so I know the vibe you're going for, plus the date and location.
Whatever feels most like you. Bring a second fit if you want options.
Filmed in 4K or 1080p, and edits are exported in 1080p or 4K.
